nodes.label: Gemini semantic extraction backend
nodes.rationale: graphify needs no API key. Code is AST-extracted with no LLM. Gemini is used for semantic extraction only if GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY is already set; otherwise the host agent itself acts as the LLM, so the pipeline never blocks waiting for a key.

nodes.label: Step 3B2 - spawn_agent/wait_agent/close_agent dispatch (Codex)
nodes.rationale: The Codex platform has no Agent tool for parallel subagent dispatch, so it uses spawn_agent + wait_agent + close_agent instead, requiring multi_agent=true under [features] in ~/.codex/config.toml. Functionally equivalent to Claude Code's Agent-tool fan-out, but a different mechanism.

nodes.label: Constrained query vocabulary expansion
nodes.rationale: graphify query matches via case-folded substring + IDF only - no stemming, no synonyms, no cross-language match. If the user's wording differs from the graph's node labels the literal matcher returns 0 hits and the answer collapses to noise, so the query terms must first be expanded against the graph's own extracted vocabulary before traversal.

nodes.label: Confidence score rubric (EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS)
nodes.rationale: Models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges; production data showed a bimodal collapse (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+) when guidance was a free range, so the rubric now forces a pick from fixed values (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) with AMBIGUOUS as the escape hatch instead of ever defaulting to 0.5.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge (use AMBIGUOUS when unsure); never skip the corpus-size warning; always show token cost; never hide cohesion scores; never run HTML viz on >5000 nodes without warning. Keeps the audit trail honest and prevents silently misleading outputs.
